d: Veteran actress Ratna Pathak Shah joins Guest in the Newsroom for a candid conversation. She reminisces about her journey in the world of theater, including her iconic role in the cult sitcom Sarabhai vs Sarabhai. Ratna also opens up about her personal life, sharing anecdotes about her marriage to Naseeruddin Shah, her family, and her children. She fondly recalls her days at the National School of Drama (NSD) and delves into the world of Marathi, Hindi, and English theater. Ratna also discusses her experience working with Rohit Shetty in Golmaal 3 and her foray into the OTT space. Don't…
